headline: Dataprev reports early test-stage use of Brazil’s Chat GOV.BR service
summary: In a report published June 1, 2026, Dataprev described the first six months of Brazil’s INSPIRE public-sector AI program. It said the Chat GOV.BR service reached about 2,000 digital attendances per day during testing and that the assistant resolved more than 60% of attendances. The report does not define the resolution denominator or period, and these are agency-reported figures rather than independently measured service outcomes.
